decisions.reason: As a very recent launch that builds on the firm’s established airport-systems portfolio and was publicly presented as a new industry standard, management is likely to continue backing it rather than admit failure or write off fresh development and launch investments.

Although its public commitment appears less emphatic than for Product A, it still fits the firm’s core integrated airport-operations direction in a growing market, so management would be inclined to retain it and give it more time rather than withdraw it quickly.
